notes.title: PATCH NOTE ! Demo Version 0.1.05 Released!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back for more patch notes!
This update is one of the biggest so far: it brings a wide range of bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, system optimizations, and brand-new features.

Notable highlights include:

[list]
[*] Building improvements & new Facade View mode
[*] Smarter tutorial flow with better detection and UI improvements
[*] Numerous building & placement fixes
[*] Improved AI behavior for clients and employees
[*] Major optimizations to performance and save/load systems
[*] More accurate economy, notifications, and rewards
[/list]

As always, we encourage you to share your feedback on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uvBcvumbcR]DISCORD[/url] in the #bug-and-feedback channel!
[/p]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

Added Facade View mode, allowing the building’s front to be displayed in focus.

New rectangular wall & paint placement tool (not just linear).

Clients can now sit on sofas in the lobby (new AI behavior).

Added a proper end credits sequence after finishing the game.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Time & Systems[/h3]

Increased overall game time speed.

Improved save/load system for walls, objects, and furniture.

[h3]Building & Placement[/h3]

Walls of the same type no longer duplicate costs.

Rotation resets to default orientation when selecting a new item.

Removed obsolete “placo foundation” item.

Demolition mode now shows the resale value of objects.

Starting broken objects now have a sell price.

Better mouse detection on objects depending on map position.

Doors and wall counters now restore walls when destroyed.

Chairs now snap correctly to tables.

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]

Tutorial waits until room validation before progressing.

Correct detection for wall building (not confused with painting).

Improved tutorial selection & clicks.

Tutorial UI windows slightly larger for readability.

Tutorial now forces pause mode.

Tutorial dialogues can be skipped by clicking anywhere on UI.

[h3]User Interface[/h3]

Esc closes all windows.

Renaming rooms now requires one click.

Task UI font size increased.

Money notifications no longer block building.

No more debit notifications when placing items from inventory.

Archives keep selection until stock is empty.

Notifications are now newest first.

Duplicate notifications now stack.

Rewards now display correctly (Samy & critics).

[h3]Economy & Missions[/h3]

Cloakroom income credited properly.

Difficulty now affects attendance (bonus Easy, malus Hard).

Film catalog prices display correctly, even in pause.

Clean all dirt / floor trash mission expanded to multiple stains.

[h3]Performance & Optimization[/h3]

Optimized Auto-Reduce Wall View (less lag).

Optimized archives menu.

[h3]Localization[/h3]

Improved Chinese localization.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[h3]Building & Objects[/h3]

Fixed bug preventing wall placement in room-construction.

Fixed duplication bug with overlapping walls.

Fixed issue where objects on tables glitched below or failed to rotate.

Fixed detection issues for wall-mounted objects.

Fixed bug where wall decorations couldn’t be deleted.

Fixed bin state not saving properly.

Fixed poster rotation glitch and giant poster bug.

“News Films” can no longer be used as posters.

[h3]Clients & Employees[/h3]

Fixed bug where clients left screenings early at midnight.

Fixed bug where pitchman & pianist left before screenings ended.

Fixed wardrobe employees glitching under their counter.

Fixed client AI getting stuck in toilets, lobby, or seats. Blocked characters now despawn.

Fixed buyers freezing unexpectedly.

Fixed employee work schedules detection.

[h3]UI & Notifications[/h3]

Fixed bug where message dates didn’t match send times.

Fixed bug where notifications overlapped visually.

Fixed bug where some rewards appeared empty.

[h3]Missions & Events[/h3]

Fixed bug where L’Enfant de Paris unlocked too early.

Fixed mismatch in film rarity display between purchase and reel management.
[/p]

notes.title: PATCH NOTE ! Demo Version 0.1.04 Released!
notes.content:
[p]This patch focuses on fixing major blocking bugs that were preventing some players from properly completing the tutorial or even interacting within the game.
We sincerely apologize for these inconveniences and are doing our best to resolve any issues that may harm your gameplay experience. As a reminder, we are a small team of two, and we remain on the lookout for bugs that might occur on specific PC configurations we could have missed.

We encourage you to test this update, see how the fixes improve your experience, and report any remaining issues on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/uvBcvumbcR]SWG DISCORD[/url] in the #bug-and-feedback channel.
[/p][h2]v0.1.04 – 12/08/2025[/h2][p]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Major fix: after launching the game on low-end configurations, inputs were sometimes locked, making the game unplayable. This is now resolved.
[/p]
[b]General[/b]

Improved fade-in/fade-out transitions for the first layer, enhancing visual fluidity.

Stability improvements to the start procedure when beginning a new game.

[b]Tutorial & Camera[/b]

Camera now locks at the start of the tutorial in a new game, providing a clearer onboarding experience.

Fixed an issue where the end cinematic triggered unwanted camera movement when autosave was enabled.

[b]Localization[/b]

Improved Chinese localization for better accuracy and readability.

notes.title: PATCH NOTE ! Demo Version 0.1.03b Released!
notes.content:
[p]Welcome back for more patch notes!  
This series of updates brings a wide range of bug fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and helpful additions for players. Notable highlights include:

- Expanded freedom in player programming  
- Improved UI and overall clarity  
- Core system reworks (tutorial, placement, object handling)  
- Numerous visual and functional bug fixes  
- Direct access to our Discord server from the main menu

We encourage you to download the demo, test all the new features, and share your feedback on our [url="https://discord.com/invite/uvBcvumbcR"]Discord[/url], in the #bug-and-feedback channel.  
 [/p][h2]v0.1.03b – 04/08/2025[/h2][p]
[b]General[/b]  
- Added a Discord logo to the main menu with a direct link to our server.

[b]Schedule UI[/b]  
- Improved seasonal alert system in the schedule interface for better clarity.

[b]Localization[/b]  
- Improved English localization with more natural phrasing and consistent terminology.
[/p][p]
[/p][h2]v0.1.03 – 03/08/2025[/h2][p][b]Building & Placement[/b]  
- Floors can no longer be placed outside the building area.  
- Floor build speed adjusted for smoother placement.  
- Fixed persistent room selector bug when building new rooms.  
- Wall paint visuals no longer appear cropped.  
- Improved placement behavior for wall-mounted objects.  
- Door placement now respects proper offsets.  
- Auto-generation of colliders on game start now works correctly.

[b]Lights & Facade[/b]  
- Fixed a lighting bug on the building facade.  
- Large projector lights now respect proper distance limits.  
- Interior decorative lights are now brighter and more consistent.  
- Particle systems no longer appear inside the building when they shouldn't.

[b]Furniture & Objects[/b]  
- Object hitboxes adjusted for more accurate interactions.  
- Locker room objects now have correct offset positioning.  
- Fixed orientation display issue with locker room wardrobes.  
- Wall-mounted and box variants for ticket counters and locker room now appear in the inventory.  
- Tables now correctly save snapped chairs in position.

[b]Schedule & UI[/b]  
- Films can now be scheduled on the current day.  
- Schedule UI has been streamlined for better clarity.  
- Debug queue system has been stabilized.

[b]NPCs & Jobs[/b]  
- Cleaner NPC no longer gets stuck in front of trash bins.

[/p][h2]v0.1.02 – 01/08/2025[/h2][p][b]Tutorial System[/b]  
- Fixed the tutorial window closing automatically at the beginning.  
- Skip button now properly skips the entire tutorial sequence.  
- Camera control is now blocked during tutorial steps.  
- Dialogue text now completes instantly on click for faster reading.

[b]Room System[/b]  
- Leftover objects from previous room types are now correctly removed.  
- Room tiles and objects no longer persist after undo or cancellation.  
- Room painting is no longer blocked by dragging over UI (only initial click checks UI).  
- Objects can no longer be placed on doors or in invalid zones.  
- Room selection no longer defaults to red on creation.  
- All room-related GameObjects are properly destroyed on deletion.  
- Startup object references are now correctly initialized.  
- Improved visual sorting and collision layering between interior and facade rooms.

[b]NPCs & Visibility[/b]  
- Facade NPCs no longer disappear randomly under certain conditions.  
- Improved sorting logic to avoid visual overlap between characters and the environment.

[b]UI & Icons[/b]  
- Updated chair icon for better visual clarity.  
- Fixed category label issue for film news missions.  
- Object selection in destruction mode no longer behaves inconsistently.

[b]Camera & Display[/b]  
- Camera offset in facade view realigned for better positioning.  
- Resizing the window in fullscreen mode no longer breaks UI elements.

[b]Placement & Feedback[/b]  
- Placement zones now display correct color feedback for valid and invalid areas.
[/p]

notes.title: The Golden Age of Cinema Awaits!
notes.content:
Hello to all cinema and management enthusiasts!

We’re thrilled to be back to share the latest updates on Cinema Theater Tycoon. Today, let’s travel back to the early 20th century, where the cinematic experience was far from what you know today!

[h2]A unique atmosphere for epic beginnings[/h2]

As soon as you enter Cinema Theater Tycoon, you’ll be transported to a time when cinema didn’t yet smell of popcorn! The dark rooms resemble more of a theater, adorned with ceiling moldings, red curtains, and a projector right in the projection room. Be careful, it’s hot! These early machines are as magnificent as they are dangerous, and the slightest spark could set the place ablaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/f6e251508fd3647b2021e14825ebd5c4f22c3db6.png[/img]

[h2]Pioneers of cinema and iconic films of the 1900s[/h2]

Discover the iconic films of the 1900s that laid the foundations of cinema. In Europe, figures like Georges Méliès and the Lumière brothers in France, as well as the Pathé company, revolutionized storytelling through moving images. In the United States, cinema became a total art form with D.W. Griffith and the rise of the first major studios.

In Asia, particularly in China and Japan, early productions emerged in the early 20th century, drawing inspiration from traditional theaters and incorporating new Western techniques. You will also find some movie posters that take you back to this fascinating era.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/ec1e0f8067b55e79e108f647fc3934e93001d2f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Monetize your cinema with three revenue sources[/h2]

This era isn’t about maximum profitability! To make your theater thrive, you will have three main sources of income:

[olist]
[*] Ticket sales: Attract curious viewers with rare and exotic films.
[*] Concessions: Though still modest, these treats appeal to families.
[*] Cloakroom service: Patrons appreciate quality service, especially in winter!
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/bf4f0aa13ce1c45bf2a9c83d97b3ee34045e4bfe.png[/img]

[h2]Travel to expand your film collection[/h2]

Movies don’t come easily! You’ll need to send your buyers around the globe to get your hands on cinematic gems. Set up your busy offices, with typewriters clattering, and don’t hesitate to negotiate to acquire these big-screen masterpieces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/3aa2968d86e20086f1d20cff40daccc491033e2e.png[/img]

[h2]Keeping your audience happy is key[/h2]

Your theater needs to be clean and welcoming! Set up trash bins, restrooms, and make sure every patron feels comfortable. Customer satisfaction is key to building your reputation and, eventually, attracting more and more moviegoers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/93f53c6dcc317a738a9a616bda0156975f636764.png[/img]

[b]Add Cinema Theater Tycoon to your Steam wishlist now to stay tuned for the latest news![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433110/Cinema_Theater_Tycoon/

notes.title: Introducing Cinema Theater Tycoon 🎬
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=GeTiC81j1Wk;full][/previewyoutube]

In Cinema Theater Tycoon, you become the mastermind behind your theater. Build your auditorium, choose your film lineup, and shape your audience’s experience through strategic and creative decisions. Inspired by the atmosphere of classic cinemas, the game offers you a rich and detailed universe where every decision influences the success of your establishment.
Discover more about the game’s world and its unique features on our official website: cinematheatertycoon.com

 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/5b98cb7ae36501472496fb8e8b2726c84d2435ab.png[/img]

[b][h3]Key Features[/h3][/b]

[b]Immersive Management[/b] : Design and develop your theater by taking charge of programming, layout, and financial management.

[b]Unique Films :[/b] Handpick one-of-a-kind films from over 2000 movies spanning more than 100 years of history to create a lineup that delights your audience.

[b]Authentic Ambiance :[/b] Immerse yourself in a cozy pixel art universe with charming, quirky characters.

[b]Experience the Evolution of Cinema :[/b] Start in 1906 and evolve through new technologies, crises, and trends all the way to 2020!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45485865/ce58875f41936772213f2897ed8b869e879ecb74.png[/img]

[h3][b]Add Cinema Theater Tycoon to your Wishlist now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433110/Cinema_Theater_Tycoon/

We invite you to follow Cinema Theater Tycoon news on our website and join our community on Steam. Your feedback and suggestions will be invaluable in enriching the game experience and shaping its future evolution.

[h3][b]See you soon ![/b][/h3]
This is just the beginning of an exciting adventure in the world of cinema. Stay tuned for upcoming news, exclusive content, and many more surprises. Get ready to experience a cinematic journey like never before with Cinema Theater Tycoon!
